name: Projected No-Clashing Teaching Dimension / No-Clashing Teaching Dimension
details: The defining maximum includes the identity projection.
witness_verification: On $\mathcal Q_p$, ordinary NCTD is one whereas projected NCTD is $\Theta(\log_2p)$, by the database-owned values. Thus projected NCTD divided by one plus ordinary NCTD tends to infinity along primes $p\equiv3\pmod4$. The older six-concept strict example remains valid but is not the strongest witness.
proof: Take \(S=\mathcal X\) in the definition of \(\mathrm{NCTD}^{p}\).
